mechanism.mechanism: Utilization of diametric magnets in device design to mitigate MRI-related adverse events, specifically reducing dislodgment and migration associated with static magnetic fields.
mechanism.intervention: Replace or design standard permanent magnets in the medical device housing with diametrically magnetized magnets or passive magnetic shielding materials to minimize net stray fields and torque interactions during MRI exposure.
mechanism.expected_effect: Reduced incidence of device dislodgment, dislocation, and migration/expulsion, thereby preventing associated patient injuries such as pain and hearing impairment during or after MRI scans.
mechanism.falsification_test: Conduct in-vitro MRI exposure tests at 1.5T and 3T using prototype devices with diametric magnets versus standard magnet configurations; measure torque forces and displacement vectors; if the diametric configuration does not significantly reduce displacement compared to the standard control under identical field conditions, the mechanism is falsified.
